ctx.x: (unintelligible) the baritone. 'Who the hell put the water in the baritone,' he said. Man, you done drink so much, just spit in it. That's spit coming out. He said, that ain't no spit; somebody put water in it. The guys had put water in the baritone. See, because they got that three-note (unintelligible), and the water was (unintelligible) up in the air. Rex Jones on trumpet. Kenneth Kalton was on trumpet.
